notes.title: MAFATE - Update v0.3.6
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147019/544c1889113571eb9209c5e1c466979e2cd84fed.png"]MAFATE - Update v0.3.6
 Hello everyone! 👋  We’ve just released a small but important update to the **Pre-alpha Demo**.  



This patch focuses on polishing visuals and fixing several gameplay issues reported by you.   Thank you for your feedback — it’s helping us make MAFATE better every day! ❤️  ---  


✨ Added
 Ambient Occlusion & Decals in Balanced Quality Settings    

 Natacha’s kids’ drawings on Petunia Inn’s walls    
🛠 Fixed
 Collision stuck on Petunia’s house  

 Baby ducks falling into the void  

 Collision issue on Marla’s Duck Bridge  

 P3K not delivering all letters  


 ---  
📬 Keep the feedback coming!


We’re still in **Pre-alpha**, so every bug report and suggestion counts.  
Join our Discord to share your feedback, report bugs, and be part of the adventure!



– The Blue Ramen Studios Team
